# Chrome Autofill Bridge

Chrome makes you choose between Google Password Manager and a third-party password manager. That restriction sucks. This module fixes it.

我很讨厌 Chrome 让我在 Google Password Manager 和第三方密码管理器之间二选一。
所以做了本模块突破此限制。

Keep Google's built-in autofill alongside your preferred password manager's keyboard suggestions.

保留 Google 内置自动填充，同时使用第三方密码管理器的键盘候选。

## Setup / 安装

1. Install the APK and enable the module in LSPosed, scoped to Chrome.
   安装 APK，在 LSPosed 启用模块，作用域选择 Chrome。
2. Select a third-party autofill provider in Android settings and enable keyboard suggestions.
   将第三方密码管理器设为 Android 首选自动填充服务，并打开键盘候选。
3. Keep Chrome set to **Autofill with Google**, then restart Chrome.
   Chrome 选择 **使用 Google 自动填充**，重启 Chrome。

## Compatibility / 兼容性

Android 11+; modern Xposed API 101+; Google Chrome.
Tested on Android 17 / Chrome 152.0.7977.75 / Gboard with Bitwarden. 1Password confirmed working in a work profile.

最低 Android 11、现代 Xposed API 101+、Google Chrome。已测试 Bitwarden，工作资料中的 1Password 已由用户确认可用。

Top-level HTTPS forms only; nested iframes are skipped. Passkey, card and TOTP end-to-end flows need further testing.
目前支持 HTTPS 顶层表单，跳过嵌套 iframe；passkey、信用卡和 TOTP 完整流程仍待测试。
